mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, USER_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRICE, PRODUCT_CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_ADDRESS, PRODUCT_LAT, PRODUCT_LNG, PRODUCT_PLACE_ID, PRODUCT_REGDATE) VALUES (PRODUCT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{productCategory}, #{description}, #{productAddress}, #{productLat}, #{productLng}, #{productPlaceId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_PIC (PICTURE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PICTURE_URL, PICTURE_ORDER, PICTURE_REGDATE) VALUES (PRODUCT_PIC_SEQ.NEXTVAL, PRODUCT_SEQ.CURRVAL, #{pictureUrl}, #{pictureOrder}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
